cot_history.reasoning_cot: Analyze opponent's previous_trace for yesterday's highest bid to gauge their aggression. If my HP is low, I bid high. Otherwise, I react to yesterday's bids and current supply: outbid slightly if competition is high, or conserve funds if supply is abundant and opponents were less aggressive.

My strategy prioritizes survival by bidding high when HP is critical. I adapt my base bid based on water scarcity (demand vs. supply). I dynamically adjust bids by reacting to opponents' previous day's highest bids, matching or slightly exceeding aggressive bids to compete, and conserving budget against less aggressive players, while also managing my budget when healthy.

Given supply constraints (15-25 water, 13 requirement), only one agent can get full water, leading to fierce competition. I prioritize survival by bidding aggressively when HP is low. Otherwise, I adapt to opponent's previous bids, conserving when they are overly aggressive and I have healthy HP, or slightly outbidding them to secure the single water slot.

Analyzes own HP and remaining days to determine base aggressiveness, adjusting for supply scarcity. Critically reacts to opponent's highest bid from yesterday: if they were very aggressive and my HP is good, I back off; if my HP is low, I outbid them to survive.

My strategy dynamically adjusts bids based on opponent's previous highest bid and my current HP. I bid higher when opponents show aggression or my HP is low, especially with scarce supply or in the endgame, while conserving budget otherwise.

Opponents Alex and Eric consistently bid high (avg 90-100, max 118-130) and survived, indicating aggressive strategies. My bid will react to the highest previous opponent bid, aiming to slightly exceed it to win. I will escalate bids significantly when my HP is critical or water supply is scarce, leveraging my daily salary of 150 as a competitive baseline.

Exploit opponent's yesterday's bids by slightly outbidding them, escalating with scarcity and personal HP. Aggressively bid in emergencies and endgame, ensuring budget limits are respected to maximize survival and potential profit.

Adopted a dynamic strategy: bid aggressively when HP is critically low. When healthy, if opponents bid very high, I retreat to save budget. Otherwise, I slightly outbid the highest previous opponent bid to secure water, adjusting for supply scarcity.

Cindy's 10 HP and 13 WR make water critical daily. Strategy: consistently bid high (above Alex/Bob's average) and react to highest previous bids, escalating further on low supply days and late game, to ensure survival against aggressive opponents.

Alex and Eric consistently bid high, often exceeding my daily salary. My strategy focuses on matching or slightly exceeding their previous high bids, especially when supply is low or my HP is critical, while scaling bids based on remaining days to ensure survival and budget management.
